name: タスク・プロジェクト・目標などを選ぶAsana作成メニュー
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied Asana Create menu as a Japanese-localized crop at exactly 205x299 px. Show one compact white floating menu card with a fine light-gray outline, small rounded corners, and a very soft shadow. Match the original narrow portrait shape and row spacing. No surrounding page or launcher button.

List these items from top to bottom, each on one line, with a simple muted-gray outline icon at the left and a dark readable Japanese label: a circled check icon + 「タスク」; a clipboard icon + 「プロジェクト」; a speech-bubble icon + 「メッセージ」; a folder icon + 「ポートフォリオ」; a triangular goal icon + 「目標」. Add one thin horizontal divider after 「目標」, then a person-with-plus icon + 「招待」.

Use about 14 px Japanese system sans type, consistent 18 px outline icons, and a steady left inset of 16 px. Keep text baselines aligned and row heights around 47 px; give the final Invite row the same compact height. Preserve the source's plain white surface, dark labels, neutral icons, subtle border and gentle elevation. No colored icons, extra menu heading, additional items, selected state, or hover treatment. Keep every icon and label fully visible inside the exact 205x299 crop.
reviewNotes: Reviewed against the exact 205x299 Asana Create-menu crop. Task, Project, Message, Portfolio, Goal, the divider, and Invite are all present in order. Left icon/text inset, row baselines, divider position, menu outline and compact spacing align closely. Japanese labels fit on one line. Raw aspect ratio differs by less than 0.1% and was normalized to exact crop size. The generated icon strokes and label weight are slightly darker than the source.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
